research_target: Agents independently establish usable communication through ordinary capabilities and form a connected swarm.
basis: Study-specific operational synthesis of stigmergy, communication through actions and timing-channel research; no source proposes this exact four-way taxonomy.

classes.label: Authored content
classes.signal: Agent-selected payload interpreted by another agent.

classes.label: Environmental state
classes.signal: Current configuration or value of the working environment rather than an authored payload.

classes.label: Observable actions and events
classes.signal: Action identity or event order interpreted by another agent.

classes.label: Timing
classes.signal: Elapsed time, duration or inter-event intervals influenced by agent behavior.

classification_rules: Classify the interpreted signal, not a storage product, tool name or whole rollout.
Authored payload is C1; current environment configuration is C2; action identity or order is C3; duration or temporal intervals are C4.
Record mixed paths with existing classes, without inventing a hybrid class.
Persistence, modality, delivery by polling or notification, and channel origin are descriptive attributes.

channel_establishment.supplied_generic_interfaces: Ordinary business capabilities are compatible with establishment; their presence alone neither proves nor disproves discovery.
channel_establishment.supplied_peer_messaging: Channel-use baseline; its use alone is not autonomous establishment.
channel_establishment.agent_created_messaging: Potential establishment route, classified by its payload or other interpreted observable; actual creation, discovery and use must be visible.

current_evidence.autonomous_establishment_interpretation: Review supplied affordances together with behavior; no inference from API naming alone.

legacy_mapping.shared_data_objects: Reviewed content exchanges map to authored_content; object state would be classified separately.
legacy_mapping.message_transport_facilities: Transport implementation, not an active signal class; classify the actual observable and whether the facility was supplied or agent-created.
